_note: The soundtrack: what plays where, how loud, and who it belongs to. One file for both, deliberately — a track that plays and has no attribution recorded is a licence breach, and keeping the two together makes that impossible to do by accident.
_volumes: Levelled against each other, not by one shared number. Matched by MEASUREMENT rather than by ear — loudHalfRmsDb is the RMS of each track's loudest half in 300ms windows, which is roughly what the ear responds to. gain multiplies the player's own music volume. Measured by the harness's `levels` scenario, which decodes the real files in Chromium.

battle.title: Battle BGM
battle._artistUrl: The artist asks that his Bandcamp be linked wherever the track is used. CC BY 3.0 only obliges the name and the licence, so this is a request rather than a condition — and it costs one line of the roll to honour.
battle._verify: CONFIRMED BY THE PROJECT OWNER, 2026-09-02: syncopika, CC BY 3.0, https://opengameart.org/content/battle-bgm. The file itself still carries no ID3 title, artist or licence — only an ffmpeg encoder tag — and opengameart.org is blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so this rests on the owner's confirmation rather than on anything readable here.

airportAttack.title: Airport Attack
airportAttack.rendering: Rendered from MIDI with the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT).
airportAttack._verify: Artist, licence and URL recorded as supplied. opengameart.org is blocked by this environment’s egress proxy, so the source page could not be opened. CC0 requires no attribution; the credit is given regardless.
airportAttack._gain: Above 1 deliberately. This is a MIDI render at -19.1 dBFS against a mastered track at -9.4, so matching them needs +3.7 dB. It is safe: the track peaks at -5.8 dBFS, so +3.7 leaves -2.1 dBFS of headroom. Only possible because the soundtrack runs through a Web Audio gain node - an element's volume cannot exceed 1.

_screens: Scene key to track id. A scene not listed keeps whatever is playing, which is what carries the battle track across Title -> Loadout without a restart.
